business_problem: IBM’s Big AI Models team needed to stop overprovisioning GPU-backed inference infrastructure so it could support more research workloads without wasting scarce and expensive accelerator capacity.
solution_summary: The IBM Big AI Models (BAM) team deployed IBM Turbonomic to manage resource allocation for LLM inference servers running on Kubernetes. As more generative-AI projects entered testing, the team saw that fixed instance sizing and manual monitoring were leaving GPU resources underused while also consuming staff time. Turbonomic ingests real-time performance data from the application environment and generates AI-driven recommendations for scaling CPU, memory and GPU-backed resources up or down. The BAM team configured those actions so the platform could right-size inference servers automatically, improving cluster efficiency while preserving performance for development workloads. In effect, the solution turned infrastructure management into a continuous optimization loop, freeing engineers from manual tuning and making more idle GPU capacity available for additional model experiments.

solution_components.name: IBM Turbonomic
solution_components.role: Continuously analyzes utilization and automates resource actions to right-size LLM inference workloads on Kubernetes.

data_flow: Runtime telemetry from LLM inference servers feeds IBM Turbonomic, which analyzes demand in real time and triggers scaling actions that rebalance Kubernetes resources and free GPU capacity for additional workloads.
business_outcome: The BAM team reduced manual performance monitoring, reclaimed GPU capacity and improved the efficiency of its research and development environment for generative AI testing.
metrics: 5.3 times increase in idle GPU resources
architecture_clues: Optimizes resource allocation for LLM inference servers on Kubernetes
Uses AI-driven recommendations and automated actions
Applied inside IBM’s primary R&D environment for generative AI projects
evidence_quotes: To optimize their GPU resources and manage their LLM Kubernetes instances, the IBM BAM team deployed IBM Turbonomic®.
Using real-time data, Turbonomic generated AI-driven recommendations for automated actions to optimize resource utilization and efficiency.
By scaling down overprovisioned instances, the team show the ability to increase the idle GPU resources from 3 to 16 (5.3 times).
